summary: Extracts grounded, cited notes from meeting records for a stated focus.
name: cog-meeting-notes
description: Context Cog. Extracts grounded, cited notes from meeting records for a stated focus. Depends on a Cog providing an OpenAI-compatible model endpoint.

frontmatter.name: cog-meeting-notes
frontmatter.description: Context Cog. Extracts grounded, cited notes from meeting records for a stated focus. Depends on a Cog providing an OpenAI-compatible model endpoint.

frontmatter_raw:
type: cog [0.1]
name: cog-meeting-notes
description: Context Cog. Extracts grounded, cited notes from meeting records for a stated focus. Depends on a Cog providing an OpenAI-compatible model endpoint.
version: "0.1.0"
license: BSD-3-Clause
publisher: Example Organization
manifest: pixi.toml
manifest_schema: openteams/cog-manifest [0.1]
metadata:
  category: meetings
  maturity: experimental

profile.summary: Extracts grounded, cited notes from meeting records for a stated focus.

profile_raw:
[workspace]
name = "cog-meeting-notes"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Extracts grounded, cited notes from meeting records for a stated focus."
channels = ["conda-forge"]
platforms = ["osx-arm64", "linux-64"]

[dependencies]
python = ">=3.11"

[tasks]
ask = "python src/cog_cli.py"
serve = "python src/cog_api.py"
check = "python src/cog_cli.py --check"
resolve = "python src/cog_resolve.py"
use = "python src/cog_use.py"
eval = "python src/cog_eval.py"
test = "python -m unittest discover -s tests -v"

[tool.cog]
schema = "openteams/cog-manifest [0.1]"
id = "example/cog-meeting-notes"
license = "BSD-3-Clause"
kind = "context"
owner = "cogs@example.org"
frames = []
memory = "none"
prohibits = ["send_external_message", "modify_calendar"]

[tool.cog.context]
instructions = "context/system.md"
input_schema = "context/input-schema.json"
output_schema = "context/output-schema.json"
output_example = "context/output-example.json"

[tool.cog.io]
accepts = ["task_request"]
produces = ["notes"]

[tool.cog.evaluation]
fixtures = ["evals/smoke.fixture.yaml"]

[[tool.cog.requires]]
capability = "model-endpoint/openai-compatible"
locality = "any"
satisfied_by = { cog = "example/cog-small-model", version = ">=0.1.0" }
also_satisfied_by = [{ cog = "example/cog-other-model" }]

[[tool.cog.interfaces]]
name = "web-api"
kind = "http-json"
task = "serve"
endpoint = "http://127.0.0.1:8093/ask"
default = true

[[tool.cog.interfaces]]
name = "cli"
kind = "command"
task = "ask"

[[tool.cog.interfaces]]
name = "health"
kind = "command"
task = "check"
body:
# Meeting Notes

## Purpose

Extracts grounded, cited notes from meeting records for a stated focus.

## Using it

```bash
pixi run resolve
pixi run ask -- --bundle examples/sample-bundle.json
```
